sentences.text: The evidence shows that the bank’s floating retail loans are linked to the policy repo rate of the Reserve Bank of India, but it does not state today’s repo rate.
I could not find any in-force RBI document in the evidence that gives the RBI repo rate as of 2026-11-23.

missing.slot: today's RBI repo rate as of 2026-11-23
missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force bank loan documents and RBI-related evidence provided, including references to the policy repo rate and interest-rate directions, but found no evidence stating the current repo rate value.
